learning_outcomes.text: Students can derive vocational pedagogical questions or problems and systematically and theoretically process them, considering existing criteria of scientific work.
Students can plan and prepare vocational training, apply training methods, and design the conclusion of training.
Students can describe the process of developing a teaching-learning arrangement and apply it illustratively.
Based on the framework curriculum of a vocational training occupation, students can illustratively interpret a selected learning field, didactically transform it, and document it in writing.

Students can recognize interfaces between vocational pedagogy and general and subject-specific didactics in the context of vocational education research and empirical teaching research, explain them, and use them in lesson planning.

syllabus_topics: Scientific work: planning, structuring, writing, and preparing texts for publication
Learning field and competence-oriented design of lessons
Action-oriented methods for training, instruction, and teaching
Training regulations, training plan, and examination
Current research subjects, research questions, and research methods in educational and vocational education research
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
